panels.title: Explain why a fish looks closer to the surface than it is. (3 marks)
points: Light from the fish refracts at the water surface
It speeds up and bends away from the normal
The brain traces rays back in straight lines, so the fish appears higher
Answer: Three linked points: effect, what light does, what we see
